purpose: Define a non-circular proof root for deterministic Hyperposition U/D/GRF candidate labels before any positive D/E training promotion. This contract is a method/evaluator design artifact only and mints no dataset, model, runtime or training credit.
successor: one exact source-bound implementation and mutation-test capsule in the existing Hyperposition authority lane
target_architecture: semantic Hyperposition as cross-cutting cognitive carrier inside the variable-N HCU grid, with deterministic evidence/update/resolution semantics and no competing truth/effect authority

research_delta.finding: Placing event/content/state/discriminator digests only inside the same mutable candidate row or formal-world object does not by itself create immutable provenance. A self-consistent mutation can change both payload and co-located digest. Positive D/E promotion therefore needs a proof root whose expected identities are derived from exact bound generator/evaluator source or an independently equivalent immutable manifest, not accepted from the candidate row itself.
research_delta.counterhypothesis: Full replay from genesis is not always necessary if a source-manifest-bound snapshot proof is shown by mutation tests to be equivalent to replay for every semantic field relevant to U, D, discriminator coverage and GRF observation promotion.

requirements: exact generator/evaluator repo path and byte digest are bound
generator/evaluator deterministically emits or exposes an immutable proof manifest keyed by proof_id
manifest expected values are recomputed from the bound source, not read as authority from the candidate row
genesis Hyperposition state identity is manifest-bound
ordered event history identity is manifest-bound
event_id -> event_content_sha256 mapping is unique and fail-closed
each event is replayed through the deterministic independence/relation/update chain
reconstructed canonical semantic state equals supplied state_before exactly
resolution proof names the decisive discriminator receipts that eliminated each applicable competitor
exact generator/evaluator repo path and byte digest are bound
bound source deterministically exposes proof_id -> state_proof_manifest entry
manifest entry binds genesis digest, ordered history digest, event digest map, state_before digest and discriminator-receipt-set digest
candidate-carried hashes are treated only as claims and must equal recomputed manifest expectations
proof construction has mutation coverage equivalent to full replay for every semantically relevant field
no second state or evidence authority is introduced

event_identity_contract.law: independence_qualified is derived by the evaluator path and cannot be the immutable semantic root; event identity must remain stable independently of that derived boolean
event_identity_contract.collision_rule: same event_id with any different event_content_sha256 fails closed across current event and complete prior history
event_identity_contract.history_rule: every evidence record contributing to sigma/E_plus/E_minus/F must resolve to exactly one manifest-bound event digest

required_predicates: event_id/event_content_sha256 match the replayed decisive event
observed_outcome_digest matches the replayed observed outcome
every eliminated applicable competitor is covered by at least one decisive receipt
receipt set is source-manifest-bound and cannot be enlarged by candidate self-assertion
discriminator_proof_contract.anti_goodhart: u_test_order pair-separation rank is an ordering hint only; it is not proof of admissibility, execution, outcome correctness or sufficient competitor coverage

grf_observation_contract.law: OBSERVED cannot be promoted from a naked evidence_qualified_observation boolean. The evaluator must bind a typed observation receipt to event content, source/provenance, observation identity and scope.
grf_observation_contract.fallback: without the typed receipt, retain UNKNOWN/HYPOTHESIS/METHOD_ONLY as applicable and mint zero positive epistemic-label credit

mandatory_mutation_capsule: candidate row + co-located event digest mutated consistently
candidate row + co-located state digest mutated consistently
preseeded FALSIFIED sigma without replay-producing event
preseeded F record with unbound event digest
event removed while state_before left unchanged
one applicable competitor missing decisive coverage
extra candidate-injected decisive receipt absent from source manifest
GRF OBSERVED promotion with boolean but no typed observation receipt

external_method_inputs.source: OpenReview: Rectifying Demonstration Shortcut in In-Context Learning
external_method_inputs.bounded_takeaway: Models can follow semantic/demo priors instead of the intended input-label relation; supports explicit remapping/equivariance and shortcut tests rather than target-frequency balance alone.

external_method_inputs.source: ICML 2025/OpenReview: Does learning the right latent variables necessarily improve in-context learning?
external_method_inputs.bounded_takeaway: Recovering a task latent can still fail to yield robust downstream use; supports separate READ/BIND_ROUTE/WRITE scoring rather than treating latent readout as sufficient.

external_method_inputs.source: arXiv 2605.29971: Causal Interventions on Continuous Variables: A Case Study on Verb Bias in Steering Vectors for In-Context Learning
external_method_inputs.bounded_takeaway: Representation content and downstream causal use can diverge; supports intervention plus downstream behavioral criteria for J-Space promotion.

external_method_inputs.source: arXiv 2604.24693: Contextual Linear Activation Steering of Language Models
external_method_inputs.bounded_takeaway: Steering reliability can depend on context; supports context-indexed J-Space/vector-control evaluation instead of one global-vector assumptions.

next_exact_action: Implement one source-manifest-bound proof interface in the existing Hyperposition gate/generator lane, then run the mandatory mutation capsule. Do not generate positive D/E rows before that pass.
